Concurrently, I'm refactoring the Kafka integration tests to handle both embedded and external broker profiles. I'm also developing sample Spark batch and streaming modules.

technical_and_design_decisions: Centralize version property reading in `publish-maven.gradle` using standard Gradle properties parsing from `dependencies.properties`.
Update log pattern in `xd-container-logger.properties` to include full date timestamp (`yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss,SSS`).
Refactor Kafka integration test base classes to allow toggling between external/standalone broker instances and embedded test servers via system properties.
Develop Scala Spark streaming module and Java/Scala Spark batch sample using standard Spring XD module packaging structures.
Audit Sonar issues by categorizing into actionable bugs/vulnerabilities vs. false positives/invalid flags to mark in Sonar Qube.
assumptions: The developer has full access to the project repositories, SonarQube instance, and project Wiki.
Local development environment supports JDK 17+ and local running instances of Spark and Kafka for testing.
All work is executed by a single developer with familiar context in Spring XD, Gradle, and JVM languages (Java/Scala).

activities.activity_name: Develop Spark Streaming Scala Module and Deployment Support
activities.activity_description: Create and configure a Spark Streaming module using Scala for Spring XD deployment, including module configuration and deployment packaging.

activities.activity_name: Update Wiki Documentation for ulimit Configurations
activities.activity_description: Document recommended ulimit settings (10K) under a new Troubleshooting section in the wiki to prevent 'Too many open files' exceptions in distributed setups.
Modify `xd-container-logger.properties` to add date formatting to container log messages for enhanced troubleshooting capability.

activities.activity_name: Refactor Kafka Tests for Separate/External Broker Execution
activities.activity_description: Update Kafka integration tests to execute against an external broker or separate process, reducing build overhead and memory footprint.
Update `publish-maven.gradle` script to dynamically pull dependency versions (such as Spring Boot and `hadoop-common`) from `dependencies.properties`.
Review outstanding Sonar code violations, fix relevant issues, and flag irrelevant rules or false positives as invalid.
Create a complete Spark batch job sample project demonstrating distributed data computation capabilities within Spring XD.
Run full test suites, verify Gradle publishing, and test sample deployments end-to-end to ensure system integrity.
